condition: Run only if b01-template-v2 has >=2 fact-qualified candidates in >=2 realization clusters (the v2 gate in results/b01-template-v2/report.json). If v2 fails, do not run b02-v2; keep these files as an unused conditional preparation and report the v2 failure.

v2.status: requested, no outputs at freeze time; its gate decides whether v3 runs

relationship.v3Scope: Five coverage cases from the frozen public pack, same six seeds, same model/sampling/cap/rubric and the v2 writing instruction. No pooling with b01 or b01-template-v2.

template.system: You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.
template.instruction: 请把下面的已结算状态写成一段中文小说正文，180 到 260 字。必须写出【本回合变化】里的移动、时间推进、物品变化和人物变化；可以写细微动作、对白和视角人物的感受，但不得新增人物、物品、地点、事件、往事或承诺；不要逐条复述状态，不要写标题或列表。

hypotheses.statement: The v2 instruction produces fact-qualified prose on at least two of the five categories, with at least two non-homogeneous qualified realizations in those cases.
hypotheses.test: Six seeds per case under the same model/sampling; 01 rubric + lane 12 diversity; per-case results reported, no cherry-picked case.
hypotheses.falsifiedBy: Fewer than two cases pass the per-case diversity gate, or any category is fully fact-unqualified.

hypotheses.statement: The instruction helps long single-view scenes but not multi-person/no-change/item-transfer cases.
hypotheses.test: Compare per-category fact findings and clusters; report the failing categories rather than averaging them away.

duplicateAndQualificationRules.inherited: Same normalization, fingerprints, four homogeneous rules, complete-link clustering, ambiguity band, effectiveRepetition = 1 - distinctRealizationClusters/6 and qualifiedDistinctClusters count.
duplicateAndQualificationRules.factPerspective: Same 01 RUBRIC.md and reviewNarration; factQualified = no fact finding; readableQualified = pass only; pending never passes.
duplicateAndQualificationRules.noPooling: b01, b01-template-v2 and b02-generalization-v2 are separate prompts/batches; never pool their samples for clustering or rates.

analysisPlan.arms: The all-subset addendum (analysis-addendum-arms.md, sha256 12c9c428a0fc0277e3a5d559f2bf067b5657db4f513fee40ae785d05b5be89b3) applies: every C(6,N) subset is one trial.
analysisPlan.armGate: At least two cases with >=2 fact-qualified non-homogeneous candidates and no fully fact-unqualified case. If the gate fails, arms are not computed.
analysisPlan.primary: Per-case factQualified count, qualifiedDistinctClusters, effectiveRepetition and finding kinds; aggregate only after per-case table.
analysisPlan.noBenefitClaim: This batch tests generalization of the template; a best-of-N benefit still needs the arm comparison and a repeatable improvement over N=1. Zero qualified in any case forbids N expansion.

decisionRules.gateFail: If fewer than two cases pass the per-case diversity gate, do not run best-of-2/4. Report which categories failed and why; do not relax the rubric or add seeds.
decisionRules.gatePass: If at least two cases pass and no case is fully fact-unqualified, compute the all-subset N=1/2/4 arms. Benefit only if an N>1 arm is strictly better on the preregistered endpoints.
decisionRules.zeroQualified: Any fully fact-unqualified case is reported; if the whole batch has zero fact-qualified, stop this template line and take the evidence to 02/06.

resource.device: one HPC GPU; fp16 on V100 if needed
